head_coach.name: Tony Popovic
head_coach.play_style_summary: Emphasizes a structured back-three build-up with a tight double midfield pivot. Focuses on defensive compactness, counter-pressing, and utilizing attacking midfielders playing between the lines to create vertical progression.

key_players.name: Alessandro Circati
key_players.performance_stats: He is a dominant force in Serie A with Parma, showcasing strong aerial presence and the ability to build play out from the back [2.1.4].

key_players.name: Jordan Bos
key_players.performance_stats: A versatile left-back playing in the Eredivisie for Feyenoord, known for his attacking threat down the flank and solid defensive recovery.

key_players.name: Nestory Irankunda
key_players.performance_stats: A highly explosive winger with incredible pace and individual flair, providing a potent threat on transitions.

injuries_and_absences.absence_reason: Sustained a hamstring injury during Middlesbrough's Championship playoff final defeat, ruling him out of the squad [1.2.2].
